Contract CoCoMESystem::receiveOrderedProduct(orderID: Integer): Boolean {
	definition:
		orderProduct: OrderProduct = OrderProduct.allInstance()->any(o|o.Id = orderId)
	precondition:
		orderProduct.oclIsUndefined() = false and
		orderProduct.OrderStatus = RECEIVED
	postcondition:
		orderProduct.ContainedEntries->forAll(oe|oe.Item.StockNumber = oe.Item.StockNumber+oe.Quantity) and
		orderProduct.oclIsUndefined() = false
}
